items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes the associated string representation and performs case-insensitive comparison to the result of the given AggregationExpression.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式接收关联的字符串表示形式，并将其与给定AggregationExpression的结果进行不区分大小写的比较。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes the associated string representation and performs case-insensitive comparison to the given value.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式使用关联的字符串表示形式，并与给定值执行不区分大小写的比较。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes the associated string representation and performs case-insensitive comparison to the referenced fieldReference.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式使用关联的字符串表示形式，并执行与引用字段 reference 的大小写不敏感比较。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。

items.source: Uses of StringOperators.StrCaseCmp in org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation
items.translation: StringOperators.StrCaseCmp 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation 中的用途
